product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native platform that helps large enterprises model, plan, optimize, and execute supply-chain decisions using algorithms and AI agents.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and /pricing returns a 404.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in Lyric's list of organizations using Lyric Studio.

eng_blog.notes: Two implementation-focused posts cover storage/cache architecture and distributed modeling workflows, authored by engineering staff and an engineering-trained technical founder.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link appears in the navigation or footer; the linked resources are marketing and educational content.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applied AI / GTM Engineer is open in Bengaluru. Despite its GTM placement, the role builds production AI tools and agents rather than directly selling AI.

model_provider.notes: Lyric explicitly says it combines these foundation models with other forecasting techniques and offers customer-data fine-tuning.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and GDPR alignment; GDPR alignment is not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Current company pages report a $55.5M Series B in 2025 without specifying a month. The original announcement, dated 2025-08-05, reported $43.5M; no dated explanation of the increase was found.

raised_18mo.notes: The $43.5M Series B announcement on 2025-08-05 falls within the requested 18-month window.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch announcement was found for 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09. Recent posts discuss existing capabilities or industry recognition; the identified NVIDIA cuOpt integration announcement is dated 2025-03-18.
